name: cornerblock-inventory
description: Cloud-Based Materials Inventory Management System with Email Notification for Cornerblock Trading Inc.

scripts.dev:emulators: node tools/free-emulator-ports.mjs && firebase emulators:start --only firestore,auth --project cornerblock-inventory
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:rules && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project cornerblock-rules-test "vitest run tests/rules"
scripts.test:integration: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project cornerblock-inventory "vitest run tests/integration"
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
